name: New Feature
description: Add new functionality, endpoint, component, or behavior to an existing or new module.

default_promises.description: Unit tests for all new functions
Integration tests for new I/O boundaries
Type check passes with no new errors
Lint passes with no new violations

clarifying_questions.question: Is this a new module or an addition to an existing module?
Does this feature expose a new API or change an existing one?
Does this feature require a database schema change?

example_contract:
CONTRACT: CTR-FEATURE01
  TYPE: FEATURE:PLANNED
  SCOPE: src/module/new-function.ts
  MODULES: module-a
  RISK CAP: MEDIUM
  PROMISES:
    1. Implement spec → verify: diff_inspection
    2. Unit tests → verify: test_passes
    3. Type check → verify: type_check
  STATUS: proposed
